title: Hailing from Los Angeles, Tay Toe looks to take over Hip-Hop
htmlContent:
Los Angeles-born hip-hop artist Tay Toe is a talented singer and songwriter who began making music at a very young age and boasts a unique background of musicianship in line with his lifelong fascination with rap. Tay Toe showcases his ability to go bar for bar, keeping his lyrics thrilling and entertaining with the release of his recent track,” Invincible.”

Tay Toe’s “invincible” is a song for the broken-hearted. As usual, he delivers his verses with a unique style that displays a smooth vocal. Tay Toe adds much replay matter to the track, making it refreshing. “Invincible” is a concentrated melody that quickly finds a way to implant itself into the listener’s mind.
